value: For nearly 25 years, Galois has specialized in delivering trustworthy, reliable, and secure solutions for the world's most critical systems. Their team of computer scientists, cryptographers, mathematicians, and cognitive scientists applies mathematical rigor and creativity through custom research and engineering to protect national security, financial transactions, and private data. Trusted by leading defense, fintech, and cloud organizations, Galois invites interested partners and clients to connect and explore collaborations.
